design_detail: Progressive tax on total wealth above 2,000 national minimum wages

grading_note: In his interview he describes a one-off net-wealth levy; the accompanying article specifies 4% and an exemption for a typical household.

design_detail: Discusses a potential wealth tax on the rich as one of two ways of financing a pandemic response, rather than a detailed policy endorsement.

quote_en: a potential wealth tax to raise resources from the richest
source_title: Quando a pandemia ataca sobretudo quem trabalha
grading_note: Presents a potential wealth tax as an option alongside immediate income taxes; cautious C because she calls for consideration rather than adoption.

design_detail: Calls for consideration of additional taxes on people with substantial wealth; the assets and design are not specified.
quote_original: é preciso pensar na criação de outras formas de impostos que possam onerar aqueles que têm muito património
quote_en: it is necessary to consider creating other forms of taxes that can burden those with substantial wealth
source_title: Quando a pandemia ataca sobretudo quem trabalha
grading_note: Refers to taxing those with substantial assets separately from income-tax reform, but does not specify the tax base; C as apparent support.

design_detail: At a 2025 campaign event explained and defended the Bloco proposal, reported as a progressive tax on fortunes above €3 million.
quote_original: Francisco Louçã, cabeça de lista do Bloco por Braga, e Mariana Mortágua a explicarem por que é necessário tributar as grandes fortunas
quote_en: Francisco Louçã, the Bloc’s lead candidate for Braga, and Mariana Mortágua explaining why it is necessary to tax large fortunes
source_title: Francisco Louçã e Mariana Mortágua dão aula sobre justiça fiscal em Guimarães
grading_note: First-hand event report attributes advocacy to him and describes the specified Spanish-style proposal. Quotation is the reporter’s description, not a direct quotation from Louçã.

design_detail: Calls for a wealth tax; the available article excerpt does not state a rate, threshold or precise asset base.
quote_original: Criando um imposto sobre a riqueza, sobre bens de propriedade e especulação financeira.
quote_en: By creating a wealth tax, on property assets and financial speculation.
source_title: Somos um país pobre? Resposta a José Miguel Júdice e Susana Peralta
grading_note: Publisher author page contains excerpt of her signed opinion piece; tax design not specified in accessible text.

design_detail: Advocates a progressive tax on fortunes above 3,500 minimum wages (about €3 million), with rates between 1.7% and 3.5%; frequency and net basis not specified in this text.
quote_original: Este imposto aplica-se a fortunas acima dos 3.500 salários mínimos nacionais - cerca de três milhões de euros
quote_en: This tax applies to fortunes above 3,500 national minimum wages — around three million euros
source_title: As respostas para as nossas crises
grading_note: Signed opinion column presents and advocates a specific threshold and rates; the text does not state a net basis or frequency.

design_detail: Models a progressive tax on individual net wealth above the top 0.5% threshold, at marginal rates of 1.7%, 2.1% and 3.5%; includes a Portugal-specific estimate.
quote_original: These policy agendas are (i) the implementation of a moderate, progressive wealth tax, and (ii) full beneficial ownership transparency for all types of companies and assets.
quote_en: These policy agendas are (i) the implementation of a moderate, progressive wealth tax, and (ii) full beneficial ownership transparency for all types of companies and assets.
source_title: Tax the Rich: From Slogan to Reality
grading_note: Group-commissioned policy report explicitly recommends a progressive wealth tax and separately models Portugal on page 65. Publication date corroborated by RTP reporting on 20 September 2023.

design_detail: Advocated the Bloco proposal, described as a progressive tax on fortunes above 1 million euros; the report does not specify the tax base or frequency.
quote_original: Demonstramos que há alternativas aos cortes, que são mais justas, mais solidárias e não têm os efeitos recessivos do corte dos subsídios
quote_en: We demonstrate that there are alternatives to cuts that are fairer, more solidary and do not have the recessionary effects of cutting the allowances.
source_title: BE propõe imposto sobre luxo e mais-valias urbanísticas e pequeno-almoço gratuito nas escolas
grading_note: The report attributes advocacy of two proposed taxes to Soares; it describes the fortune-tax thresholds separately. The broader contemporaneous wealth-tax proposal is reported at https://www.dn.pt/arquivo/diario-de-noticias/be-defende-imposto-sobre-as-grandes-fortunas.html.

design_detail: In interview calls for fiscal reform targeting large fortunes; the accompanying party platform specifically proposes a tax on large fortunes without giving a base or frequency.
quote_original: Para uma justa repartição da riqueza é urgente uma reforma fiscal que atinja as grandes fortunas e os lucros das grandes empresas que fogem ao fisco.
quote_en: For a fair distribution of wealth, fiscal reform targeting large fortunes and the profits of large companies that evade tax is urgent.
source_title: Entrevista a Catarina Martins
grading_note: Interview is printed alongside a platform explicitly calling for a wealth tax. The interview wording alone does not define the tax base.

design_detail: Advocates a progressive wealth tax of 1.7% to 3.5% on the richest 0.5%; its separate 2025 research estimates Portugal-specific proceeds.
quote_original: Applying a minimal wealth tax on the superrich and making multinational corporations pay the dodged taxes they owe can cover the majority of countries’ climate finance costs
quote_en: Applying a minimal wealth tax on the superrich and making multinational corporations pay the dodged taxes they owe can cover the majority of countries’ climate finance costs
source_title: Reassert tax sovereignty to unlock trillions for climate finance
grading_note: The network advocates wealth taxation globally; its Portugal-specific analysis is in table 4 of https://taxjustice.net/wp-content/uploads/2025/08/Taxing-extreme-wealth-What-countries-around-the-world-could-gain-from-progressive-wealth-taxes-Tax-Justice-Network-working-paper.pdf.
